events.root: Gene names are independently shifted against effect values.

turn_overrides.T1: Shift each count column to the next metadata row and swap disease/control factor labels.
turn_overrides.T3: Map positive effects to control-up genes.
turn_overrides.T6: Associate each gene name in the ranking with the log2-fold-change value from the following table row before identifying the maximum.

human_repair_overrides.content: Shift each count column to the next metadata row and swap the disease/control labels, but reuse the archived results.
Interpret positive effects in the reused coefficient as control-up.
Cyclically assign each of the ten displayed log2FoldChange values to the preceding gene name, so AL050350.1 receives SLC7A3's 4.802780, and report AL050350.1 as the maximum.
